evolution_concern: Allow a visitor to register initial adoption interest from an animal profile while keeping adoption acceptance under human review.
literature_grounding: ArcAssist-Web logical reference architecture: evidence-grounded Web architectural evolution
ArcAssist-Web Bot: decision-support bot prepares decision material and preserves architect review

web_and_domain_context.interaction_flow: animal profile -> interest form -> API registration -> administrative review
web_and_domain_context.domain_rule: Public adoption interest is blocked only when the animal is IN_ADOPTION_PROCESS.
web_and_domain_context.human_review_boundary: Interest does not automatically approve adoption or change animal status.
web_and_domain_context.volume_assumption: The public and administrative interfaces must remain readable with dozens of animals.

implemented_changes: Added compact public animal feed with square media tiles.
Added compact administrative inventory for many animals.
Separated administrative screens for inventory, animal creation, animal editing, and interest requests.
Added administrative interest counts grouped by animal.
Displayed animal-level interest counts inside each administrative inventory row.
Changed interest eligibility to block only IN_ADOPTION_PROCESS.
Expanded shared demo animals and Prisma seed to dozens of fictitious records.
Added AdoptionInterest domain entity and status enum.
Added adoption-interests API module with DTOs, service and repositories.
Added public AdoptionInterestForm in animal detail page.
Added service tests for available and unavailable animals.
Prepared Docker execution script and service healthchecks for repeatable validation.
Updated scope, architecture, backlog, domain model, prototype docs, ADR and diagrams.

limitations: Browser validation and screenshots for Prototipo 2.1 still pending.
The Docker startup path applies Prisma db push automatically, but the browser flow must still be manually exercised after startup.
